expectations.text: Describes the SEC's May 19, 2026 proposal, which would limit 404(b) auditor attestation to large accelerated filers and raise the large accelerated filer threshold
expectations.evidence: The May 19, 2026 proposal is never identified; the response only says the SEC "has signaled interest in revisiting filer categories" and that no proposal it knows of is final.

expectations.text: States comments closed July 20, 2026 and there has been NO final action as of November 2026
expectations.evidence: No mention of the July 20, 2026 comment deadline or the proposal's status; the response says "Verify the current status... I do not have live access."

expectations.text: Concludes current 404(b) thresholds remain operative law, so preparation should not pause
expectations.evidence: "Short answer: do not pause. As far as I know, there is no enacted change that exempts you from SOX 404(b)" plus the current accelerated/large accelerated thresholds stated as operative.

expectations.text: Frames the proposal as proposed only, to be flagged and monitored
expectations.evidence: "A proposal published for comment does not change your obligations" and "Track the SEC's regulatory agenda, any proposals, and legislation. Set a decision point for FY2027 planning."

expectations.text: Notes management's 404(a) assessment obligation is unaffected either way
expectations.evidence: "Section 404(a) management assessment applies to all non-EGC issuers, and it is not eliminated by any proposal I know of" and "Management still owes the 404(a) assessment."
